name: hcw-azmigrateorchestrator-addon
description: Hybrid Cloud Works Migration Explorer — the slim web-front edition of the Azure Migration Orchestrator: CSV lab API, the pane app the website frames at /tools/migration, and site integration, built on the published core (ADR-0028, ADR-0030). The two upstream packages are the tarballs attached to the upstream GitHub Release of the pinned v* tag, by URL and integrity hash; core-update.yml bumps the tag. Workspace manifests use "*" for them.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && npm run build --workspace apps/lab-web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npx playwright test
